title: Age of Bismuth [More ores & tools]
description: New ores, new tools and more !
body:
Last changlog:  

-Fixed soulgold armor parts' names

-Enhanced bismuth brute texture

-Enhanced crystal staff texture

-Enhanced crystal tear texture

-Ported to 1.21.8


------------------------------------

In the aim of making minecraft vanilla better I'm doing some mods and resource packs with vanilla-like content.  


Age of Bismuth introduce 3 new unique materials to the game:  

-**Bismuth**  

↳can be obtained by mining bismuth ores (screenshot in media) spawning in the nether between  
    Y=0 and Y=40, you'll need to smelt some bismuth brut to get some bismuth ingot  

↳act as a golden armor to piglins, they won't attack you if you wear the armor set  


-**Embergold** (1.21.1-1-0-4 only)  

↳can be crafted with gold, bismuth brut, blaze powder and magma cream (example in media)  

↳the armore gives fire resistance, by sneaking you'll burn near entities  


-**Soulgold** (1.21.1-1-0-4 only)  

↳can be obtain by using a soul fire camp, right clicking with an embergold item on it will summon its soulgold version (example in media)  

↳the armore gives fire resistance, by sneaking you'll burn near entities  


-**Embergold** items and armor have more durabily but are less efficient and deal less damages than  
  **Soulgold** items and armor  

-**Bismuth** items and armor are more efficient than netherite items but are worse at enchanting  



This mod also adds a new creature called the sad soul which is useful to get a powerful staff:  

-the sad soul attacks every undead entity  

-by killing a sad soul (neutral until hit) you have a small chance to get a living twig  

-by using 2 of them and some other materials you'll be able to craft the crystal staff (examples in media)  

-the crystal staff allows you to freeze near entites (exept players)
